_comment: Recall ground truth for the pre-i18n Excalidraw checkout. Method: Excalidraw added i18n in commit `i18nCommit` ("Internationalization support (#477)"). Its parent `beforeCommit` is the last pre-i18n state, where these strings were hardcoded. `groundTruth` = the strings that commit actually converted to t() AND that existed as hardcoded literals at the parent (catalog values minus labels the commit *introduced*, e.g. toolbar `Rectangle`/`Diamond`/`Selection`/`Arrow`/`Line`/`Text` which existed only as lowercase code values like `type === "rectangle"`). Matching is case-insensitive (the catalog normalized casing: source `Send to Back` → catalog `Send To Back`). This stage runs only if the Excalidraw checkout is present locally with full history; otherwise it is skipped.

knownMisses._comment: Documented, accepted limitations — NOT silent regressions. Track here so a recall drop below the expected ~90% signals a real problem. (Copy Styles / Paste Styles / Select All were recovered once adapter.detect was extended to scan .ts files.)
